views.accessibility:
- main:
  - paragraph: SUBSCRIPTION WORKSPACE
  - heading "Team annual" [level=1]
  - navigation "Workflow screens":
    - button "List"
    - button "Detail"
    - button "Edit"
    - button "Timeline"
  - region "Subscription screen":
    - text: Human-readable plan label shown in headers.
    - textbox "Human-readable plan label shown in headers.": Team annual
    - text: Current lifecycle status of the subscription.
    - combobox "Current lifecycle status of the subscription.":
      - option "Future"
      - option "Trialing"
      - option "Active"
      - option "Paused"
      - option "Pending Cancellation" [selected]
      - option "Past Due"
      - option "Unpaid"
      - option "Terminated"
    - heading "Cancellation Form" [level=3]
    - text: Reason Code
    - combobox "Reason Code":
      - option "no_longer_needed"
      - option "budget"
      - option "duplicate"
    - text: Reason
    - textbox "Reason": Budget changed for next year
    - text: Billing interval
    - combobox "Billing interval":
      - option "monthly"
      - option "yearly" [selected]
    - text: Billing amount USD
    - textbox "Billing amount": "19.99"
    - checkbox "Whether the subscription will cancel at the natural billing period end." [checked]
    - text: Whether the subscription will cancel at the natural billing period end. Free-form explanation captured during cancellation workflows.
    - textbox "Free-form explanation captured during cancellation workflows.": Budget changed for next year
    - text: Timestamp when cancellation was initiated.
    - textbox "Timestamp when cancellation was initiated."
    - text: ISO 4217 currency code used for billing.
    - textbox "ISO 4217 currency code used for billing.":
      - /placeholder: Enter currency
      - text: usd
    - text: Payment instrument category used for collection.
    - combobox "Payment instrument category used for collection.":
      - option "Enter payment method type" [disabled]
      - option "card"
      - option "ach"
      - option "wire" [selected]
      - option "invoice"
      - option "other"
    - text: Billing contact email address.
    - textbox "Billing contact email address.":
      - /placeholder: Enter customer email
      - text: customer3@example.com
    - text: Lifecycle event associated with the most recent timestamp mutation.
    - textbox "Lifecycle event associated with the most recent timestamp mutation.":
      - /placeholder: Enter last event
      - text: payment_received
    - text: Recurring price expressed in minor units (e.g., cents).
    - spinbutton "Recurring price expressed in minor units (e.g., cents).": "1999"
    - text: Recurrence cadence (monthly, yearly, quarterly, etc.).
    - textbox "Recurrence cadence (monthly, yearly, quarterly, etc.).":
      - /placeholder: Enter billing interval
      - text: yearly
    - button "Save"
    - group "Screen actions":
      - button "Cancel subscription"
      - button "Change"
      - button "Submit"
  - status: Changes saved in this session.
